name: Not Trust!
long_description: Do not trust? Why is that the title of the Video Game? Could it be that there is some kind of Glitch that should make me distrust this Video Game? I don't know, but I won't know what you mean by this title, if I don't try it.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
